title: The Secrecy of the Conversation with Zedekiah
description: King Zedekiah asked Jeremiah to keep the conversation secret from the nobles and told him what to answer if they asked. When the nobles came, Jeremiah answered as the king had commanded – that he begged not to be sent back to Jonathan's house to die there. So they left him in peace [ref:Jer 38:24-27|Jeremiah 38:24-27].
